download_t5_tokenizer: download the google t5-v1_1-xxl tokenizer using AutoTokenizer from pretrained
save_t5_tokenizer: save the pretrained t5 tokenizer to a local directory using save_pretrained
load_t5_tokenizer: load the google t5-v1_1-xxl tokenizer from the transformers library
run_tokenizer_script: run the t5 tokenizer script to download and save the tokenizer locally
review_tokenizer_script: review the t5 tokenizer script that downloads and saves a pretrained tokenizer
